cases.setup: Isolated projects and home; actual package installed from a local catalog, initially inactive.
expect: A useful package operation succeeds after enable, repeated invocation, double reload, fresh-process restart and re-enable.
Disable and removal detach owned hooks; independent settings survive.
forbidden: Duplicate notifications or writes; effects from a disabled package; import errors on restart.

cases.setup: The exact checksum-pinned release archive is extracted and installed into an isolated scope.
expect: The installed candidate performs a useful operation and survives the full package lifecycle.
forbidden: Falling back to working-tree package code or leaving the candidate active after removal.

cases.setup: The actual package is loaded through the public SDK into isolated projects/homes with filesystem-backed state, controllable dependencies and real local HTTP/process fixtures.
expect: Every declared requirement has an executed assertion body and a recorded per-requirement observation.
Errors, denied actions, cancelled work and restarted state retain their documented effects.
forbidden: False success, leaked scope/private input, unfinished child processes, silent lost writes or source-only behavior substituting for archive behavior.
